basis: Official published API list rates, not invoices or subscription cash charges.

openai_modifiers.unknown_tier: Assume standard list rate and mark this explicitly; do not claim actual invoiced tier.

limitations: Unsupported models remain unpriced. No manifest-selected model is substituted without request metadata.
Reasoning tokens are a subset of output; never add reasoning output a second time.
Per-record costs concern captured native requests/responses only. Family coverage can remain unknown.
No regional-processing modifier is inferred; only supplied explicit service-tier and prompt-length rules are applied.

collector_input_semantics.base-context: attempts[].usage.input is uncached ordinary input; inputTotal includes cache categories. Only native attempt records are priced.
collector_input_semantics.codex: response_receipts[].usage.input_tokens includes cache read/write categories; subtract reported cache categories before pricing ordinary input. Model comes from source turn_context, not verified backend resolution.
collector_input_semantics.reasoning: reasoning_output_tokens is already inside output_tokens; not added.

timestamp_caveat: Base uses sentAt/admittedAt when recorded. Codex rollout timestamp is only a timestamp proxy, not exact provider dispatch time.
